the-usual-short-01.mp3.text: Sit down and let the chair take your weight.

the-usual-short-02.mp3.text: Keep the eyes open, with a soft gaze.

the-usual-short-03.mp3.text: Point at something in front of you — a wall, a cup, a window.

the-usual-short-04.mp3.text: Now turn the finger around, and point at the place where others would see your face.

the-usual-short-05.mp3.text: Looking now, not from memory — is there a face here, or open space?

the-usual-short-06.mp3.text: Thoughts will arrive. Treat them as trains. You can watch them pass without boarding.

the-usual-short-07.mp3.text: If you already got on one, notice that. Step back onto the platform.

the-usual-short-08.mp3.text: Rest as the space this is all happening in.

the-usual-short-09.mp3.text: When you stand, stand as the same space.

the-usual-long-01.mp3.text: Find a seat you can stay in without fussing.

the-usual-long-02.mp3.text: Let the chair take your weight. You do not have to hold yourself up.

the-usual-long-03.mp3.text: Keep the eyes open. A soft gaze is enough — not staring, not shut.

the-usual-long-04.mp3.text: Take in whatever is in front of you — the color, the light, the simple fact of seeing.

the-usual-long-05.mp3.text: Now point at something out there. A wall, a cup, a window.

the-usual-long-06.mp3.text: Notice that it is a thing, with color and shape, at a distance.

the-usual-long-07.mp3.text: Turn the finger around, and point at the place where others would see your face.

the-usual-long-08.mp3.text: On present evidence — looking now, not from memory — is there a color here? A shape? A face?

the-usual-long-09.mp3.text: What is actually given on this side of the finger?

the-usual-long-10.mp3.text: If you find space instead of a face, you are not missing something. You are seeing what is here.

the-usual-long-11.mp3.text: Thoughts will arrive. Treat them as trains. You can read the destination without getting on.

the-usual-long-12.mp3.text: If you already boarded, that boarding is just another train, visible from the platform.

the-usual-long-13.mp3.text: You are not a passenger. You are the space the trains pass through.

the-usual-long-14.mp3.text: A memory of the past is an image appearing now. A plan for the future is a picture appearing now.

the-usual-long-15.mp3.text: I will be quiet for a while. Stay with this looking. If you get lost, point in again.

the-usual-long-16.mp3.text: Let the finger rest. The looking can stay without the gesture.

the-usual-long-17.mp3.text: Carry this into the next ordinary thing.

big-head-mode-short-01.mp3.text: Sit so you can forget the sitting. Eyes open.

big-head-mode-short-02.mp3.text: Point out at a thing. See it clearly — color, shape, distance.

big-head-mode-short-03.mp3.text: Now point back at where others see your face.

big-head-mode-short-04.mp3.text: What is here, on this side of the finger?

big-head-mode-short-05.mp3.text: The world is there. Space is here. Both at once.

big-head-mode-short-06.mp3.text: Let a thought pass through that space. Do not follow it.

big-head-mode-long-01.mp3.text: Sit so you can forget the sitting.

big-head-mode-long-02.mp3.text: Eyes stay open. Take in the room without naming it well.

big-head-mode-long-03.mp3.text: Point at a wall, or a cup, or a window. A thing, out there.

big-head-mode-long-04.mp3.text: Now point at your chest. Also a thing, with a location.

big-head-mode-long-05.mp3.text: Now point at the place others see your face.

big-head-mode-long-06.mp3.text: Single question: looking at what is given, is there a face here?

big-head-mode-long-07.mp3.text: Color? Shape? A pair of eyes? Or space, for the whole world to appear in?

big-head-mode-long-08.mp3.text: Keep one finger pointing in, and one pointing out.

big-head-mode-long-09.mp3.text: The world is there. No face here. Both at once. This is two-way looking.

big-head-mode-long-10.mp3.text: You can rest the hands. The looking does not need the gesture.

big-head-mode-long-11.mp3.text: Sounds appear in this same space. Thoughts appear in this same space.

big-head-mode-long-12.mp3.text: Nothing to improve, and no one behind the view who needs to wake up.

big-head-mode-long-13.mp3.text: I will be quiet. If you drift, point in again. What is here?

big-head-mode-long-14.mp3.text: Stand as the same no-face the room is appearing in.

open-focus-short-01.mp3.text: Sit easy. Eyes can close, or stay softly open.

open-focus-short-02.mp3.text: Is it possible to imagine the space between your eyes?

open-focus-short-04.mp3.text: The space inside the mouth, and the throat.

open-focus-short-05.mp3.text: Now the space around the body — behind you, above you, below the seat.

open-focus-short-06.mp3.text: See if inside and outside can be one continuous space.

open-focus-short-07.mp3.text: Rest in that. Diffuse is enough.

open-focus-long-01.mp3.text: Sit easy. You can close the eyes, or leave them soft.

open-focus-long-02.mp3.text: Is it possible to imagine the space between your eyes?

open-focus-long-03.mp3.text: Can you imagine the space between your ears?

open-focus-long-04.mp3.text: The space inside your throat. Not the throat. The space.

open-focus-long-05.mp3.text: Can you imagine space between the fingers — all of them at once?

open-focus-long-06.mp3.text: Hands filled with space. Arms filled with space.

open-focus-long-07.mp3.text: The whole body filled with space, as if the body were a volume, not a surface.

open-focus-long-08.mp3.text: Now include the space around the body. Behind you. Above. Below the seat.

open-focus-long-09.mp3.text: See if inside and outside can be one continuous space.

open-focus-long-10.mp3.text: Sounds happening in that space. Thoughts too. You do not have to hold it tight.

open-focus-long-11.mp3.text: Diffuse attention is enough. Wide, not sharp.

open-focus-long-12.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Stay with space, not with objects.

open-focus-long-13.mp3.text: Gently come back. The room is still here.

just-breathe-short-01.mp3.text: Sit or lie down. Close the mouth. Breathe through the nose.

just-breathe-short-02.mp3.text: Let the breath be light. This is not a performance.

just-breathe-short-03.mp3.text: A little slower, only if that is easy.

just-breathe-short-04.mp3.text: If the mind runs, let it. Keep the nose breathing.

just-breathe-short-05.mp3.text: Stay with the next breath only.

just-breathe-long-01.mp3.text: Sit or lie down. Mouth closed. Breathe through the nose.

just-breathe-long-02.mp3.text: Let the breath be light, and quiet. Not a performance.

just-breathe-long-03.mp3.text: A little slower, if that is easy. No strain.

just-breathe-long-04.mp3.text: Feel the air at the nostrils. In. Out.

just-breathe-long-05.mp3.text: If you can, let the belly move a little more than the chest.

just-breathe-long-06.mp3.text: If the mind runs, let it. You are not failing. Keep the nose breathing.

just-breathe-long-07.mp3.text: No need to empty anything. The breath is already happening.

just-breathe-long-08.mp3.text: Light. Slow. Low in the body.

just-breathe-long-09.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Stay with the next breath only.

just-breathe-long-10.mp3.text: That is the whole practice. Nothing else to get right.

dzogchen-short-01.mp3.text: Sit. Eyes open. Leave the view as it is.

dzogchen-short-02.mp3.text: There is already knowing here. You do not have to make it.

dzogchen-short-03.mp3.text: A thought appears. Let it be a thought. Do not follow, do not fight.

dzogchen-short-04.mp3.text: Rest as the knowing in which the thought appeared.

dzogchen-short-05.mp3.text: If you get involved, notice that. That noticing is the same knowing.

dzogchen-short-06.mp3.text: Leave it. Already awake is not a future state.

dzogchen-long-01.mp3.text: Sit. Eyes open. Leave the view as it is.

dzogchen-long-02.mp3.text: You do not need a special state. Knowing is already happening.

dzogchen-long-03.mp3.text: Look: who is looking? Do not answer with a story. Look.

dzogchen-long-04.mp3.text: Whatever appears — sound, thought, the room — appears in this knowing.

dzogchen-long-05.mp3.text: You do not have to hold the knowing. It holds the appearances.

dzogchen-long-06.mp3.text: A thought about practice is just another appearance. Let it go by.

dzogchen-long-07.mp3.text: No need to improve this moment, or to become someone who is meditating well.

dzogchen-long-08.mp3.text: If you get lost, that getting lost is known. Rest there.

dzogchen-long-09.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Leave everything as it is.

dzogchen-long-10.mp3.text: This was not a technique to keep. It is what is always the case.

mahamudra-short-01.mp3.text: Sit upright, at ease. Eyes open or barely so.

mahamudra-short-02.mp3.text: Turn attention around, as if mind were looking at mind.

mahamudra-short-03.mp3.text: What does mind look like, when you look directly?

mahamudra-short-04.mp3.text: If you find no thing there, do not fill the gap. Leave it.

mahamudra-short-05.mp3.text: Thoughts can move. Mind remains unstained, like space.

mahamudra-long-01.mp3.text: Sit upright, at ease. Eyes open, or barely open.

mahamudra-long-02.mp3.text: For a moment, let attention rest on the breath. Then let even that go.

mahamudra-long-03.mp3.text: Turn the looking around. Let mind look at mind.

mahamudra-long-04.mp3.text: What do you find? A shape? A color? A watcher sitting behind the eyes?

mahamudra-long-05.mp3.text: If you find no object there, that is not a failure. That is the look.

mahamudra-long-06.mp3.text: Thoughts may still arise. Let them arise and dissolve, like writing on water.

mahamudra-long-07.mp3.text: You do not have to stop them. You do not have to follow them.

mahamudra-long-08.mp3.text: Leave mind as it is. Fresh. Uncontrived. Already free.

mahamudra-long-09.mp3.text: I will be quiet. If you start managing the mind, drop the managing.

mahamudra-long-10.mp3.text: Nothing to take with you. The looking is already yours.

zen-short-02.mp3.text: Eyes lowered. Soft gaze on the floor ahead.

zen-short-03.mp3.text: This is the practice. Nothing extra.

zen-short-04.mp3.text: A thought arrives. Open the hand of thought. Let it go.

zen-short-05.mp3.text: Return is not a failure. Return is the practice.

zen-long-02.mp3.text: Eyes lowered. Soft gaze on the floor a few feet ahead.

zen-long-03.mp3.text: Hands at rest. Jaw unclenched. This is enough.

zen-long-04.mp3.text: You are not here to improve this moment.

zen-long-05.mp3.text: A thought arrives. Open the hand of thought.

zen-long-06.mp3.text: Return is not a failure. Return is the practice.

zen-long-07.mp3.text: Sounds, pressure, breath — they belong to the same sitting.

zen-long-08.mp3.text: Do not add a story about how well this is going.

zen-long-09.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Just sit.

zen-long-10.mp3.text: When the time ends, stand without leaving.

who-am-i-short-01.mp3.text: Sit. Let the body be quiet.

who-am-i-short-02.mp3.text: A thought is here. Ask, gently: who is this appearing to?

who-am-i-short-03.mp3.text: Do not answer with a name, or a story. Look.

who-am-i-short-04.mp3.text: Whatever you find — or fail to find — stay with that.

who-am-i-short-05.mp3.text: The one who would finish this practice is another thought.

who-am-i-short-06.mp3.text: Rest as what does not come and go.

who-am-i-long-01.mp3.text: Sit. Let the body be quiet. Soft eyes, or closed.

who-am-i-long-02.mp3.text: Notice a thought, or a feeling, as it appears.

who-am-i-long-03.mp3.text: Ask, gently: who is this appearing to?

who-am-i-long-04.mp3.text: Do not answer with a name. Do not answer with a biography. Look.

who-am-i-long-05.mp3.text: If a person appears as the answer, that person is another object. Who is it appearing to?

who-am-i-long-06.mp3.text: You are not looking for a better thought. You are looking for the one who thinks.

who-am-i-long-07.mp3.text: What remains when the answer falls silent?

who-am-i-long-08.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Keep the question alive, without chasing it.

who-am-i-long-09.mp3.text: There is nothing to conclude. Leave it open.

vipassana-short-01.mp3.text: Sit still. Eyes closed if that helps.

vipassana-short-02.mp3.text: Feel the breath at the nostrils, or the belly. That is the home base.

vipassana-short-03.mp3.text: When a thought pulls you, note it — thinking — and return.

vipassana-short-04.mp3.text: When a sound appears, note hearing, and return.

vipassana-short-05.mp3.text: You are not trying to stop anything. You are seeing it change.

vipassana-short-06.mp3.text: Keep returning. That is the practice.

vipassana-long-01.mp3.text: Sit still. Eyes closed if that helps.

vipassana-long-02.mp3.text: Feel the breath at the nostrils, or at the belly. Let that be home base.

vipassana-long-03.mp3.text: When attention wanders, you will notice. That noticing is mindfulness.

vipassana-long-04.mp3.text: Note it simply. Thinking. Hearing. Pressure. Then return to the breath.

vipassana-long-05.mp3.text: Do not narrate a story about the thought. One word is enough. Then let it go.

vipassana-long-06.mp3.text: Pleasant or unpleasant — same instruction. See it. Let it change.

vipassana-long-07.mp3.text: Nothing here is a problem to solve. Everything here is passing.

vipassana-long-08.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Note, and return.

vipassana-long-09.mp3.text: Open the eyes. The same seeing can walk out of the room.

samatha-short-02.mp3.text: Rest attention on the breath, wherever it is easiest to feel.

samatha-short-03.mp3.text: When you wander, come back. No commentary.

samatha-short-04.mp3.text: The breath does not need to be special. Ordinary breathing is the object.

samatha-long-01.mp3.text: Sit comfortably, with a straight back. Close the eyes.

samatha-long-02.mp3.text: Rest attention on the breath, wherever it is easiest — nostrils, chest, or belly.

samatha-long-03.mp3.text: Let the breath be natural. You are watching, not driving.

samatha-long-04.mp3.text: When attention wanders, notice, and place it back. That is the whole skill.

samatha-long-05.mp3.text: No drama about wandering. A wandering mind is the reason for the practice.

samatha-long-06.mp3.text: If it helps, feel one whole in-breath, then one whole out-breath.

samatha-long-07.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Stay with the breath. Return as many times as you need.

samatha-long-08.mp3.text: Let the attention widen. Then open the eyes.

metta-short-02.mp3.text: Bring to mind yourself, as you are right now. Not the improved version.

metta-short-03.mp3.text: Quietly: may I be safe. May I be at ease.

metta-short-04.mp3.text: If that feels false, do not force it. Offer the wish anyway, like setting a cup down.

metta-short-05.mp3.text: Now someone easy to care for. May you be safe. May you be at ease.

metta-long-01.mp3.text: Sit easy. Soften the face and the hands.

metta-long-02.mp3.text: Bring to mind yourself, as you actually are. Not a better edition.

metta-long-03.mp3.text: Say, inwardly, and slowly: may I be safe. May I be at ease. May I not be governed by these trains of thought.

metta-long-04.mp3.text: If warmth does not come, that is fine. The words are the practice, not the mood.

metta-long-05.mp3.text: Now someone who is easy to care for. See their face. May you be safe. May you be at ease.

metta-long-06.mp3.text: A neutral person — someone you pass and do not think about. The same wish.

metta-long-07.mp3.text: If you can, include someone difficult, without pretending the history is gone. May you be free from suffering.

metta-long-08.mp3.text: Widen once: all of us, in this same predicament. May we be at ease.

metta-long-09.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Rest in the wish, or in the simple fact of sitting.

metta-long-10.mp3.text: Come back. Keep one phrase if you want it: may I be at ease.

parts-short-01.mp3.text: Sit. Close the eyes if you like.

parts-short-02.mp3.text: Notice who is here. A worried part, a driven part, a tired part. Do not pick a fight.

parts-short-03.mp3.text: Ask, inwardly: how old does this part feel? Then wait.

parts-short-04.mp3.text: You are not the part. You are the space it is appearing in.

parts-short-05.mp3.text: Thank it for trying to help. You can drive from the platform.

parts-long-01.mp3.text: Sit. Close the eyes if you like.

parts-long-02.mp3.text: Notice who showed up. A worried part, a critic, a pusher, a tired one.

parts-long-03.mp3.text: Do not merge with it, and do not exile it. See it, as you would see a train.

parts-long-04.mp3.text: Ask, inwardly: what are you afraid would happen if you did not do this job?

parts-long-05.mp3.text: Wait. Parts speak in images, in tightness, in half-sentences. That counts.

parts-long-06.mp3.text: You are not the part. You are the one who can listen. The platform, not the passenger.

parts-long-07.mp3.text: If another part jumps in to manage this one, notice that too. Room for both.

parts-long-08.mp3.text: Thank them. They have been working. You can take the wheel for now.

parts-long-09.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Stay in the space that can hold all of them.

parts-long-10.mp3.text: Come back slowly. No need to resolve the story.

humming-short-01.mp3.text: Sit or stand. Mouth closed. Breathe in through the nose.

humming-short-02.mp3.text: On the next out-breath, hum a single easy tone. Not loud. Just a hum.

humming-short-03.mp3.text: Again. In through the nose. Hum on the way out. Let the chest and face vibrate.

humming-short-04.mp3.text: If a thought comes, let the tone hold you instead of the thought.

humming-short-05.mp3.text: Keep humming. I will be quiet while you do.

humming-short-06.mp3.text: Stop. Feel the silence after the sound.

humming-long-01.mp3.text: Sit or stand. Shoulders easy. Mouth closed.

humming-long-02.mp3.text: Breathe in through the nose. On the out-breath, hum a single easy tone.

humming-long-03.mp3.text: Not a performance. A low, ordinary hum, as if warming the voice.

humming-long-04.mp3.text: Feel it in the chest, the throat, the face. Let the vibration be the object.

humming-long-05.mp3.text: Again. In through the nose. Hum on the way out.

humming-long-06.mp3.text: If the mind runs, you are not failing. Come back to the next hum.

humming-long-07.mp3.text: You can pause between hums. The silence is part of it.

humming-long-08.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Keep an easy rhythm. Stop if you get lightheaded.

humming-long-09.mp3.text: Let the last hum fade. Sit in the after-sound.

humming-long-10.mp3.text: Open the eyes. The room is still humming, in its way.

chanting-short-01.mp3.text: Sit. Choose one simple sound. Ah, om, or a word you already use.

chanting-short-02.mp3.text: On the out-breath, say it. Out loud if you can, or under the breath.

chanting-short-03.mp3.text: Again. Same sound. No melody required.

chanting-short-04.mp3.text: Let the sound carry the attention. You do not have to think the sound.

chanting-long-01.mp3.text: Sit. Choose one simple sound. Ah, om, or a mantra you already trust.

chanting-long-02.mp3.text: This is not theater. One word, repeated, until it holds you.

chanting-long-03.mp3.text: On the next out-breath, say it. Out loud if the room allows, or quietly.

chanting-long-04.mp3.text: Again. Same sound. Same pace as the breath.

chanting-long-05.mp3.text: If you lose the word, pick it up on the next out-breath. That is the practice.

chanting-long-06.mp3.text: Thoughts will try to board. Let the sound be the platform.

chanting-long-07.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Keep the sound going, easy and even.

chanting-long-08.mp3.text: Let the last repetition fade. Sit in what remains.

chanting-long-09.mp3.text: Open the eyes. You can keep the word in the pocket of the day.

body-scan-short-01.mp3.text: Lie down, or sit. Close the eyes if that helps.

body-scan-short-02.mp3.text: Feel the feet. No need to change them. Just the sensation.

body-scan-short-03.mp3.text: Feel the lower legs, the knees, the thighs.

body-scan-short-04.mp3.text: Belly, chest, the small movement of breathing.

body-scan-short-05.mp3.text: Feel the hands, the arms, the shoulders, the face.

body-scan-short-06.mp3.text: The whole body as one field of sensation. Rest there.

body-scan-long-01.mp3.text: Lie down, or sit supported. Close the eyes if that helps.

body-scan-long-02.mp3.text: Feel the feet. Warmth, pressure, tingling — whatever is actually here.

body-scan-long-03.mp3.text: Move to the lower legs, and the knees. No need to fix anything.

body-scan-long-04.mp3.text: Thighs. Pelvis. The contact with the seat or the floor.

body-scan-long-05.mp3.text: Belly. Chest. Notice the breath moving, without taking it over.

body-scan-long-06.mp3.text: Hands. Arms. Shoulders. Let them be heavy.

body-scan-long-07.mp3.text: Neck. Jaw. The space of the mouth. The eyes in their sockets.

body-scan-long-08.mp3.text: Now the whole body at once, as one field of sensation.

body-scan-long-09.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Stay with the whole, or return to any part that calls.

body-scan-long-10.mp3.text: Wiggle the fingers. Open the eyes. Come back slowly.

walking-short-02.mp3.text: Feel the weight in both feet.

walking-short-03.mp3.text: Begin to walk, slower than usual. Heel, then sole, then toes.

walking-short-04.mp3.text: When the mind leaves, it is not a problem. Come back to the next step.

walking-short-05.mp3.text: Keep walking. The step is the sit.

walking-short-06.mp3.text: Stop. Feel the standing. Then go on with the day.

walking-long-01.mp3.text: Stand. Put the phone away. Eyes open. This is an outdoor practice if you can.

walking-long-02.mp3.text: Feel the weight in both feet before you move.

walking-long-03.mp3.text: Begin to walk a little slower than usual. No need to look strange. Just unhurried.

walking-long-04.mp3.text: Heel, then sole, then toes. Then the other foot.

walking-long-05.mp3.text: The eyes can take in the world. You are not staring at your feet.

walking-long-06.mp3.text: When a train of thought boards, notice. Come back to the next step.

walking-long-07.mp3.text: Sound, air, light — they belong. They do not need a story.

walking-long-08.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Keep walking. If you stop at a corner, that standing is the sit too.

walking-long-09.mp3.text: Stop. Feel both feet. Then walk on as the same looking.

the-circle-short-02.mp3.text: Imagine a simple boundary around this place — a circle, a room, enough space to be in.

the-circle-short-03.mp3.text: Look to one direction. See what is there. Then turn, and see the next.

the-circle-short-04.mp3.text: Four directions, then back to the center. You are the space in the middle.

the-circle-short-05.mp3.text: Rest as that center. Nothing to banish but distraction.

the-circle-short-06.mp3.text: When you are done, the circle can go. The looking can stay.

the-circle-long-01.mp3.text: Stand. If you know a banishing ritual, you may use its form. If not, this is enough.

the-circle-long-02.mp3.text: Feel the floor. You are in a place, at a time. That is the altar.

the-circle-long-03.mp3.text: Imagine a quiet boundary around this space. Not to keep the world out. To remember where you are.

the-circle-long-04.mp3.text: Face one direction. Look. What is actually there — wall, tree, sky, furniture.

the-circle-long-05.mp3.text: Turn to the next direction. Look again. Then the next. Then the next.

the-circle-long-06.mp3.text: Four looks. Then return to the center. You are not on the perimeter. You are the space inside it.

the-circle-long-07.mp3.text: If thoughts crowd, they are visitors in the circle. They do not run the place.

the-circle-long-08.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Stand in the middle. Eyes open.

the-circle-long-09.mp3.text: When you are done, let the boundary dissolve. Walk out as the same center.

afterglow-short-01.mp3.text: Sit. You do not need to hold on to what happened.

afterglow-short-02.mp3.text: If images or feelings are still here, let them be trains. Watch them pass.

afterglow-short-03.mp3.text: Do not build a religion out of a state. States end.

afterglow-short-04.mp3.text: What is here now, without the story of last night or last year?

afterglow-short-05.mp3.text: Rest as the space those leftovers are moving through.

afterglow-short-06.mp3.text: The ordinary day is the integration.

afterglow-long-01.mp3.text: Sit. You do not need to recreate anything, or to hold on.

afterglow-long-02.mp3.text: If images, insights, or feelings are still moving, let them be trains.

afterglow-long-03.mp3.text: You can watch them with interest. You do not have to board every one.

afterglow-long-04.mp3.text: A beautiful state is still a state. It will end. That is not a failure.

afterglow-long-05.mp3.text: Do not build a religion, a new identity, or a grand theory out of what visited.

afterglow-long-06.mp3.text: Ask only: what is here now, on present evidence?

afterglow-long-07.mp3.text: Point in, if you want. Space here. World there. Same as always.

afterglow-long-08.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Let the leftovers pass. Stay on the platform.

afterglow-long-09.mp3.text: Drink water. Walk. The ordinary day is the practice now.

focused-short-01.mp3.text: Sit. Pick one simple object — the breath, a sound, or a spot on the wall.

focused-short-02.mp3.text: Rest attention there. When it leaves, you will notice. That noticing is the practice.

focused-short-03.mp3.text: Return without a story about how you failed.

focused-short-04.mp3.text: The object does not have to be interesting. Ordinary is better.

focused-short-05.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Stay, wander, return.

focused-short-06.mp3.text: Let the focus soften. The same attention can go wide.

focused-long-01.mp3.text: Sit. Choose one object of attention: the breath at the nostrils, or a visual spot.

focused-long-02.mp3.text: Place attention there the way you would rest a hand on a table. No grip.

focused-long-03.mp3.text: When attention wanders — and it will — notice the wandering as a train leaving.

focused-long-04.mp3.text: Step back onto the platform, which is this object, now.

focused-long-05.mp3.text: Do not add a second object. One is enough.

focused-long-06.mp3.text: If the object itself becomes a thought about the object, return to the raw feel of it.

focused-long-07.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Stay, wander, return. That loop is the sit.

focused-long-08.mp3.text: Release the object. Notice that attention can rest without a target.

transcendental-short-02.mp3.text: Take a word you already use, or the word one. This is not a secret. It is a vehicle.

transcendental-short-03.mp3.text: Think it easily, on the breath or off it. No force. No concentration contest.

transcendental-short-04.mp3.text: If it fades, let it fade. If you remember it, pick it up again. Both are correct.

transcendental-short-05.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Easy repetition. No managing.

transcendental-short-06.mp3.text: Drop the word. Sit in what is already here.

transcendental-long-01.mp3.text: Sit easy. Close the eyes. Nothing to get right.

transcendental-long-02.mp3.text: Use a sound you already know. If you do not have one, use the word one, silently.

transcendental-long-03.mp3.text: Let it repeat itself, lightly, as if humming inwardly. No strain.

transcendental-long-04.mp3.text: Thoughts will come. That is not a problem. The word is not fighting them.

transcendental-long-05.mp3.text: If you forget the word for a while, you were not failing. Pick it up when you notice.

transcendental-long-06.mp3.text: This is not concentration. It is an easy vehicle, then the space it moves in.

transcendental-long-07.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Repeat without effort.

transcendental-long-08.mp3.text: Let the word go. Rest. Then open the eyes.

visualization-short-01.mp3.text: Sit or lie down. Close the eyes.

visualization-short-02.mp3.text: Picture a simple room you know, just for a moment. Walls, light, a chair.

visualization-short-03.mp3.text: Now drop the picture. What remains is the seeing itself, even with eyes closed.

visualization-short-04.mp3.text: If the image comes back, let it. Then notice the space it appears in.

visualization-short-05.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Image or no image — same space.

visualization-short-06.mp3.text: Open the eyes. The room you are in is not a picture.

visualization-long-01.mp3.text: Sit or lie down. Close the eyes.

visualization-long-02.mp3.text: Call up a simple place — a room, a path, a tree. Not a fantasy epic. One scene.

visualization-long-03.mp3.text: See it long enough to be sure it is an image, happening now.

visualization-long-04.mp3.text: Now let it go. Do not smash it. Just stop feeding it.

visualization-long-05.mp3.text: What is here when the picture leaves? Darkness, after-image, space — check.

visualization-long-06.mp3.text: If another picture arrives, that is another train. You are the platform.

visualization-long-07.mp3.text: The point is not a better movie. The point is to see that seeing is already happening.

visualization-long-08.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Stay with the space images appear in.

visualization-long-09.mp3.text: Open the eyes. Two-way looking: world there, space here.

hypnosis-short-01.mp3.text: Sit or lie down. You can open your eyes or stop this at any time.

hypnosis-short-02.mp3.text: Feel the heaviness of the hands, the feet, the jaw.

hypnosis-short-03.mp3.text: Each out-breath, a little heavier, as if the chair were doing the work.

hypnosis-short-04.mp3.text: You are not going anywhere. You are still the space these sensations appear in.

hypnosis-short-05.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Heavy, and aware.

hypnosis-short-06.mp3.text: Wiggle the fingers. The heaviness can go. The awareness does not.

hypnosis-long-01.mp3.text: Sit or lie down. You can open your eyes, move, or end this whenever you want.

hypnosis-long-02.mp3.text: This is not medical treatment. It is attention, using heaviness as an anchor.

hypnosis-long-03.mp3.text: Feel the hands. Let them be heavy. No need to make it happen.

hypnosis-long-04.mp3.text: The feet, the legs, the jaw. Each out-breath, a little more given to gravity.

hypnosis-long-05.mp3.text: If a part of you stays alert, that is fine. Alertness is not the enemy of rest.

hypnosis-long-06.mp3.text: Thoughts may drift. Treat them as trains. Heavy body, open platform.

hypnosis-long-07.mp3.text: You are not disappearing. You are the space a heavy body is appearing in.

hypnosis-long-08.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Stay heavy, and here.

hypnosis-long-09.mp3.text: Count one, two, three. Wiggle the fingers. Open the eyes if they were closed.

movement-short-01.mp3.text: Stand, or sit if standing is not available. Eyes open.

movement-short-02.mp3.text: Feel both feet. Begin a slow sway, as small as you like.

movement-short-03.mp3.text: The movement is the sit. You do not have to freeze to be present.

movement-short-04.mp3.text: When a thought boards, keep swaying. Come back to the next shift of weight.

movement-short-05.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Slow movement. Eyes open.

movement-short-06.mp3.text: Stillness now. Same space, not moving.

movement-long-01.mp3.text: Stand if you can. Eyes open. Phone down.

movement-long-02.mp3.text: Feel the weight in both feet. Then begin a slow sway, or a slow stretch.

movement-long-03.mp3.text: This is not exercise. It is looking, with the body allowed to move.

movement-long-04.mp3.text: Notice the next shift of weight. Heel, toe, hip. Ordinary.

movement-long-05.mp3.text: Thoughts will try to make this a workout, or a performance. Let those trains pass.

movement-long-06.mp3.text: If you want, raise the arms slowly, then let them fall. Same space throughout.

movement-long-07.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Keep moving slowly, or pause when the body wants to.

movement-long-08.mp3.text: Stand still. The stillness is not more spiritual than the sway.

power-breath-short-01.mp3.text: Sit or lie down. Never do this in water, or while driving. Stop if you feel dizzy.

power-breath-short-02.mp3.text: Mouth or nose — take thirty somewhat stronger breaths. Full in, relaxed out.

power-breath-short-03.mp3.text: After the last exhale, rest with empty lungs, only as long as it is easy.

power-breath-short-04.mp3.text: A full breath in, hold a few seconds, then let it go. Ordinary breathing now.

power-breath-short-05.mp3.text: Feel the body. You are the space this energy is happening in, not the storm.

power-breath-long-01.mp3.text: Sit or lie down. Not in water. Not while driving. Stop at the first sign of dizziness.

power-breath-long-02.mp3.text: This is one or two rounds only. You are not chasing a state.

power-breath-long-03.mp3.text: Thirty stronger breaths. In fully, out without force. I will leave space for that.

power-breath-long-04.mp3.text: Now, after an exhale, rest empty, only while it is comfortable. No heroics.

power-breath-long-05.mp3.text: Breathe in fully. Hold a few seconds. Let it go. Normal breathing.

power-breath-long-06.mp3.text: Notice the buzz, if there is one, as a sensation. A train, not a self.

power-breath-long-07.mp3.text: If you want a second round, take it now, same way. Or rest.

power-breath-long-08.mp3.text: Ordinary breath. You are the platform. The chemistry is traffic.

power-breath-long-09.mp3.text: Sit until you feel ordinary again. Then stand slowly.

mahayana-short-02.mp3.text: This space you are sitting in is not private. The same awareness holds others too.

mahayana-short-03.mp3.text: Wish, simply: may the one who suffers — including you — be free of the extra story.

mahayana-short-04.mp3.text: Now look: the wisher is also an appearance in the same space.

mahayana-short-05.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Open, and kind, without a project.

mahayana-short-06.mp3.text: Carry both — space, and the wish — into the next conversation.

mahayana-long-01.mp3.text: Sit. Soft eyes. Nothing to become.

mahayana-long-02.mp3.text: Rest as the space in which this body and these thoughts are appearing.

mahayana-long-03.mp3.text: That space is not a private room. Other lives appear in the same kind of knowing.

mahayana-long-04.mp3.text: Let a simple wish form: may we not be governed by the trains we did not choose.

mahayana-long-05.mp3.text: If that wish turns into a project, or a self-image, see that. Return to space.

mahayana-long-06.mp3.text: Compassion without a manager. Emptiness without coldness.

mahayana-long-07.mp3.text: Point in, if you want. No face here. A world there, full of others.

mahayana-long-08.mp3.text: I will be quiet. Stay open. The wish can sit in the background.

mahayana-long-09.mp3.text: Stand as the same space that includes the next person you meet.

tree-of-life-short-01.mp3.text: Sit. This is a map of attention, not a belief you have to join.

tree-of-life-short-02.mp3.text: Imagine ten places on a tree, from the ground to a crown of space.

tree-of-life-short-03.mp3.text: Rest for a moment at the crown — open, unoccupied, like the sky.

tree-of-life-short-04.mp3.text: Descend to the heart. Warmth, if it is there. If not, space will do.

tree-of-life-short-05.mp3.text: Return to the crown. Same you, two places, one looking.

tree-of-life-short-06.mp3.text: Drop the map. The tree was a scaffold. The space remains.

tree-of-life-long-01.mp3.text: Sit. Eyes soft. This is pathworking as attention only — no ranks, no current to force.

tree-of-life-long-02.mp3.text: Picture a simple tree of ten stations, from earth at the base to a crown of open sky.

tree-of-life-long-03.mp3.text: Begin at the crown. Rest as space. Nothing to hold.

tree-of-life-long-04.mp3.text: Move attention down to wisdom, then to understanding — two sides, one silence between them.

tree-of-life-long-05.mp3.text: To the heart. If warmth is here, feel it. If not, do not invent it.

tree-of-life-long-06.mp3.text: To the foundation, the body, the seat. Gravity. Contact.

tree-of-life-long-07.mp3.text: Now look both ways: crown and root, sky and seat, in one view.

tree-of-life-long-08.mp3.text: I will be quiet. You can walk the map, or sit as the space the map is drawn in.

tree-of-life-long-09.mp3.text: Let the diagram go. Two-way looking is enough: world there, space here.
